notice: SYNTHETIC ROLE-BASED SIMULATION — NOT BASED ON THESE EMPLOYEES' ACTUAL BEHAVIOR OR WORK HISTORY.
scenario_summary: Project Northstar is a fictional 48-hour hackathon to build an offline-tolerant coordination service for imaginary polar research stations. It processes synthetic beacon and supply events, exposes a status dashboard, and contains no real project data.

decisions.choice: Document that repeated event_id values return the original acknowledgement
alternatives: Return a new acknowledgement for every retry
rationale: The clarified contract makes client tests unambiguous
constraints: Only exact event_id matches are duplicates
risks: Ambiguous payload changes under one ID need rejection
decisions.outcome: Synthetic acceptance cases increased from 8 to 14 with all duplicate paths covered.

decisions.choice: Cover every required field and boundary value in parameterized tests
alternatives: Use one representative valid and invalid event
rationale: Table-driven cases make omissions visible and concise
risks: Too many overlapping cases can obscure intent
decisions.outcome: Synthetic validator branch coverage increased from 71% to 94%.

decisions.choice: Show the projection timestamp and warn after 60 seconds
alternatives: Always show the last value without age
rationale: Operators can distinguish degraded data from a live update
constraints: Use the fictional clock supplied by the test harness
risks: Clock skew could trigger a false warning
decisions.outcome: Synthetic usability checks identified stale state correctly in 20 of 20 trials.

decisions.choice: Return a stable error code plus a concise remediation hint
rationale: Stable codes support tests and safer UI behavior
risks: Hints can become outdated if contracts change
decisions.outcome: Synthetic support scenarios reached the correct remediation in 92% of 25 trials.
